original.target_description: Owen et al. (2013), Alliance in action, pp. 67–77: cross-sectional AiA validation in university counseling clients. PDF p. 6 / printed p. 72 gives multiple bivariate correlations and additive Bayesian multilevel models predicting CTSC-R and WAI-SR. The locator and description do not identify a unique interaction test or correlation.

n.sample_role: Unassigned candidate only: 170 clients nested within 42 therapists; not established for the described interaction test.
n.exclusions: Source excludes completed therapy, non-individual therapy, and incomplete surveys (including missing therapist identification or measures); 367 survey respondents preceded exclusions.

p.location: PDF p. 6 / printed p. 72, Table III note; Table IV

notes: No target was assigned from row order or numeric correspondence. The supplied reference/title matches this source, but the neutral description specifies an interaction between alliance and technique use; this source reports AiA validation, bivariate correlations, and additive multilevel models, with no uniquely identified corresponding interaction. Table III candidate CTSC-R correlations: AiA-RM r=.33, AiA-NC r=-.34, AiA-GC r=.38, AiA-PM r=.52, WAI-SR r=.55; all carry **, whose printed note is p<.01 (canonical text encodes < as B). These candidates are distinct tests; none is selected. Table IV candidate CTSC-R coefficients for AiA-RM, AiA-NC, AiA-GC, AiA-PM are .03, -.24, .21, .08, respectively; they are printed coefficients, not identified as r, and accompanied by 95% credible intervals rather than p values. No metric conversion was performed. Common analyzed-sample candidate: 170 clients and 42 therapist clusters, after exclusions described in Procedure; retained only as candidate evidence because the requested test is unresolved. No N sum or df-derived N was used. Original-side status done means the assigned source inspection is complete, not that target identity was established. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
